relationFields.name: visa_free_days
relationFields.label: Visa-free days
relationFields.desc: Allowed visa-free stay (in days) per destination; null where not visa-free or unspecified.

relationFields.name: visa_free
relationFields.label: Visa-free
relationFields.desc: 1 if the destination is visa-free (incl. unspecified-length), else 0.

relationFields.name: visa_on_arrival
relationFields.label: Visa on arrival
relationFields.desc: 1 if a visa is granted on arrival, else 0.

relationFields.name: e_visa
relationFields.label: e-Visa
relationFields.desc: 1 if an electronic visa is required, else 0.

relationFields.name: eta
relationFields.label: Electronic travel authorization (eTA)
relationFields.desc: 1 if an electronic travel authorization (eTA, e.g. ESTA) is required, else 0.

relationFields.name: visa_required
relationFields.label: Visa required
relationFields.desc: 1 if a traditional visa is required, else 0.

relationFields.name: no_admission
relationFields.label: No admission
relationFields.desc: 1 if entry is not permitted, else 0.

derivedRelationFields.name: dest_distance_km
derivedRelationFields.label: Distance to destination (km)
derivedRelationFields.desc: Great-circle distance from the passport country to each destination, in km.

derivedRelationFields.name: dest_shares_language
derivedRelationFields.label: Shares a language
derivedRelationFields.desc: 1 if the destination shares an official language with the passport country, else 0.

derivedRelationFields.name: dest_is_neighbor
derivedRelationFields.label: Shares a land border
derivedRelationFields.desc: 1 if the destination shares a land border with the passport country, else 0.

functions.name: sum
functions.desc: Sum of a per-destination vector, skipping nulls. e.g. sum(visa_free_days).

functions.name: count
functions.desc: Number of destinations where the value is non-zero and non-null.

functions.name: avg
functions.desc: Mean of non-null entries. Alias: mean.

functions.name: min
functions.desc: Minimum of a vector, or of several scalars.

functions.name: max
functions.desc: Maximum of a vector, or of several scalars.

functions.name: std
functions.desc: Population standard deviation of non-null entries.

functions.name: if
functions.desc: a where cond is truthy, else b (works elementwise).

functions.name: log
functions.desc: Natural log. Alias: ln. Also log10(x).

functions.name: round
functions.desc: Round to nearest integer. Also floor(x), ceil(x).

functions.name: clamp
functions.desc: Constrain x to the range [lo, hi].
